content: If development error detection is enabled and the Service Discovery module has not been initialized using Sd_Init(), the Sd_LocalIpAddrAssignmentChg function shall raise the development error code SD_E_ UNINIT and the Sd_LocalIpAddrAssignmentChg function shall return without further action.
